Suresh Gopi questions Karnataka's E20 fuel testing, dismisses blending concerns

Union Minister Suresh Gopi has questioned the testing methods used for E20 fuel in Karnataka, dismissing concerns surrounding ethanol blending. He stated that the testing procedures in the state are not up to par and suggested that the current approach might be flawed. Gopi's remarks indicate a potential disagreement over the implementation and verification of the E20 fuel standard, which involves blending 20% ethanol with gasoline.
